_comment: An example of the registry format. The hosts are reserved example names, not real sites. Copy entries into benchmark/sites.json, one per benchmark site. owner_type is team (the team controls the site) or permission (written permission is on file: say where in permission_note; for an after run the note must say that you have permission to change or deploy, and it is your own attestation: the tool does not verify it). verification is dns or meta (dns is not available for a host with a port). label is the file in benchmark/labels named after the host. after_eligible is true only for a site whose owner will deploy the approved files; after_method is then staging or live.

sites.label: demo.example.org.json
sites.notes: Team-owned demo site; the after run uses a staging copy.

sites.label: docs.example.net.json
sites.permission_note: Written permission from the site owner (email of 20 Nov, kept by the team) to test and to change or deploy.
sites.notes: Run with the owner's permission; the owner deploys the approved files.

sites.label: shop.example.com.json
sites.permission_note: Written OK from the owner to test (read-only) only.
sites.notes: Before-only: reported in the results, no after run.
